# spaceman user

Users: list, show, create, disable, enable and set grants.

Aliases: `users`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman user create`](#spaceman-user-create) | Create a user (a password, if any, comes from a file or standard input) |
| [`spaceman user disable`](#spaceman-user-disable) | Disable a user (ends their sessions and tokens) |
| [`spaceman user enable`](#spaceman-user-enable) | Enable a disabled user |
| [`spaceman user get`](#spaceman-user-get) | Show a user |
| [`spaceman user grants`](#spaceman-user-grants) | Replace a user's grants |
| [`spaceman user list`](#spaceman-user-list) | Users |

## spaceman user create

Create a user (a password, if any, comes from a file or standard input).

```sh
spaceman user create [flags]
```

API: `create-user` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman user create --email ada@example.com --display-name Ada --grant operator:payments --password-file ./initial
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--display-name` | string |  | display name (required) |
| `--email` | string |  | email (sign-in name) |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--grant` | string, repeatable |  | grant ROLE[:SPACE] (viewer, operator or admin; SPACE an ID or slug, default * = every space and global administration) (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `--idempotency-key` | string |  | Idempotency-Key to send (default: a fresh random key); reuse it to retry this create safely |
| `--mfa-required` | bool |  | require a second factor |
| `--password-file` | string |  | initial password (read from this file; never pass secrets as flag values) |
| `--password-stdin` | bool |  | read --password-file's value from standard input instead |

## spaceman user disable

Disable a user (ends their sessions and tokens).

```sh
spaceman user disable <user> [flags]
```

API: `get-user`, `disable-user` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
